answer: Bind each earning agent to a hardware enclave key: the chip signs a fresh quote every epoch, and payouts go to at most one live identity per device. A farm of 100 fakes must buy and power 100 devices, so its cost climbs linearly instead of staying near zero. Weakness: a cloud host can rent thousands of enclaves, a velvet glove over one farm. Fix: cap rewards at 3 identities per hosting network block, so a lotus of rented keys blooming from one data center earns like 3 agents, and the mirror-image quotes it emits stand out.
